items.t: Shift lever can move out of Park (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check the VIN to see whether it was done.

items.t: Front lower ball joint can separate
items.job: Replace front lower control arm (includes ball joint)
items.note: Price is for one side. An alignment is usually needed afterward.
Diagnosis only: the repair depends on which parts or mounts are rusted. RepairPal lists Swift noise diagnosis at $122–$179.

items.job: Replace ignition coil (if testing points to it)
items.note: Get it diagnosed first; sensors or fuel delivery may be the cause instead.

items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley (harmonic balancer) and bolt
items.note: If the timing belt was damaged, replace it too.

Based on YourMechanic (no parts-plus-labor source found): about $695 total for a 1996–2001 Swift, shops $855–$1,312; their average parts figure is $171. Adjusting the latch costs less if it is not broken.

items.t: Front brakes grab and pull hard to one side
items.note: Price is for one caliper. A collapsed brake hose is cheaper.

items.job: Replace distributor ignition coil or pickup (if testing points to it)
items.note: A fuel pump relay is cheaper; a fuel pump costs more.

items.t: Check engine light from loose or worn gas cap
items.note: YourMechanic: about $126 total for a 1999–2001 Swift, mostly minimum labor. Most owners can do this themselves.

items.t: Brake pedal pulsates from warped rotors
Owner's manual missing child seat anchor instructions (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall. Check the VIN to see whether it was done.
